summary: Self-serve Pinecone Standard plan trial: $300 in credits over 21 days with access to Standard features (bulk import, backup/restore, RBAC, higher scale limits) — no up-front payment required. One trial per organization; orgs already on Standard/Enterprise or marketplace-subscribed cannot activate it.
claim_steps: Create a Pinecone organization and activate the Standard trial in the console — no up-front payment required.
One trial per organization; quotas are blocked when credits run out or 21 days elapse.
Downgrade to Starter or add a payment method before expiry to keep access.
